help.organisationName: The legal name exactly as it stands in the company register (AJPES).
help.registrationNumber: The organisation's registration number from the register — ten digits, e.g. 5150949000.
help.vatNumber: VAT identification number, e.g. SI73291978. Leave empty if the company is not VAT registered.
help.registeredAddress: The registered address from the register: street, number, postcode and town.
help.country: Country of the registered seat, as a two-letter code — SI for Slovenia.
help.naceCode: Code of the main activity, e.g. 10.13. It is in the register entry; use the most detailed level you have.
help.reportingCurrency: Currency the report's money figures are in. For Slovenia this is EUR.
help.employeeCount: Number of people employed at the end of the reporting period, as a headcount.
help.averageFte: Average full-time equivalents over the period, from payroll — e.g. 347.72.
help.turnover: Net sales revenue for the same period, taken from the annual accounts, in the reporting currency.
help.groupStructureType: Standalone company, the parent of a group, or a subsidiary of one.
help.consolidationMethod: How this entity's figures enter the group report: by ownership share, by financial control or by operational control.
help.ownershipPercentage: Share the parent holds in this entity, in percent — 100 for a wholly owned subsidiary.
help.effectiveFrom: Date this entity became part of the group. Leave empty if it always has been.
help.effectiveTo: Date it left the group. Leave empty while it is still part of it; a date here removes it from later reports, not from past ones.
help.legalEntity: The legal entity this record belongs to. Every site, asset and data row is owned by one.
help.facilityName: Name you use for the site internally — «Plant Trnovlje», «Warehouse Koper».
help.facilityType: What the site is: plant, office, warehouse, shop or other.
help.tenure: Whether you own the site, lease it, or only manage it.
help.openingDate: Date the site started operating under your control. Leave empty if it was before the reporting period.
help.facility: Site this entry belongs to. Leave empty for something that is not tied to one site.
help.assetName: Name of the vehicle, building, machine or meter — «Van 1», «Boiler room».
help.assetType: What the entry is: vehicle, building, equipment, generator, meter or other.
help.identifier: Registration plate, serial number or meter number — whatever identifies it on a bill.
help.periodName: Name you will recognise the report by, e.g. «Year 2024».
help.startDate: First day of the reporting period, usually 1 January.
help.endDate: Last day of the reporting period, usually 31 December.
help.reportingYear: The year the report is about — the year the period ends in.
help.baseYear: The year later reductions are measured against. For a first report it is usually the reporting year itself.
help.reportingBasis: Individual — this company alone. Consolidated — the company together with its subsidiaries.
help.comparativePeriod: An earlier period to compare against. Leave empty for a first report.
help.boundaryStatus: Whether this entity is inside the report's boundary for this period, or excluded with a reason.
help.exclusionReason: Why the entity is left out of this period. It is printed in the report, so say it plainly.

help.legal_entity_id: The legal entity the consumption belongs to.
help.facility_id: The site the consumption belongs to — the plant, office or shop that used it.
help.year_month: Month the consumption belongs to, e.g. 2024-01. Leave empty for a figure that covers the whole period.
help.unit: Unit of the figure you entered — kWh, MWh, litres, m³, kg or tonnes. It must match the bill.
help.notes: Anything the reviewer should know: which bill this comes from, or that the figure is an estimate.
help.change_reason: Why an already approved figure is being changed. It stays in the history of the report.
help.source_name: What produced the emissions — «Gas boilers», «Delivery vans», «Forklifts».
help.activity_type: The fuel or substance itself: natural gas, diesel, petrol, LPG, wood, a refrigerant.
help.activity_value: How much was used in the period, in the unit you pick — the number from the bill or the meter.
help.method: How the figure was obtained: from fuel bills, from distance driven, or from a refrigerant mass balance.
help.refrigerant_added: Refrigerant topped up into the equipment during the period, in kg — from the service report.
help.refrigerant_recovered: Refrigerant recovered from the equipment during the period, in kg.
help.equipment_capacity: Total refrigerant charge the equipment holds when full, in kg — it is on the nameplate.
help.opening_stock: Refrigerant in your own store at the start of the period, in kg.
help.closing_stock: Refrigerant in your own store at the end of the period, in kg.
help.leakage_rate: Leakage assumed for the equipment, in percent of its charge per year. Use it only when no service data exists.
help.energy_type: What was bought: electricity, district heating, steam or cooling.
help.consumption: How much was bought in the period, as the supplier's invoice states it.
help.supplier: Who supplied it — the company on the invoice.
help.meter_asset_id: The meter this reading comes from, if you keep meters in the asset register.
help.renewable_share: Share of the purchased energy that is renewable, in percent, if the supplier states it.
help.instrument_type: Type of contractual document: a guarantee of origin, a green tariff or a power purchase agreement.
help.certificate_id: Identifier of the certificate or contract, so it can be traced back.
help.covered_volume: How much energy the document covers, in the same unit as the consumption it belongs to.
help.technology: The generation technology the document names: hydro, solar, wind, biomass and so on.
help.production_country: Country the energy was produced in, as stated on the document.
help.residual_mix_volume: Energy left to be reported with the residual mix — the part no document covers.
help.quality_criteria_status: Whether the document meets the market-based quality criteria; say «unknown» rather than guessing.
help.generation_period_start: First day of the period the energy was generated in, as the document states.
help.generation_period_end: Last day of that generation period.
help.cancellation_date: Date the certificate was cancelled in the registry in your name.

page.title: Spend-based Scope 3
page.subtitle: Purchased goods & services and capital goods, estimated from annual spend
page.estimateTitle: An estimate, outside your gross Scope 1+2 totals
page.estimateBody: These figures come from annual spend multiplied by EXIOBASE industry averages per €1000 — a GHG Protocol screening method for categories 1 and 2. They are reported as Scope 3 and are deliberately NOT added to the gross Scope 1 and Scope 2 totals, which are built only from measured activity entered under Inventory.

editor.gateTitle: Spend-based Scope 3 is a paid feature
editor.title: Spend-based Scope 3 (cat 1 & 2)
editor.subtitle: Annual purchased-goods & capital-goods spend per commodity · EXIOBASE per-€1000 factors · converted to EUR server-side ({year})
editor.empty: No spend lines yet — add a commodity below. With no lines, Scope-3 categories 1 & 2 stay at 0.
editor.emptyUnpriceable: No spend lines for {year}, and none can be added while the factor set in force carries no spend factors.
editor.unpriceableTitle: This period's factor set cannot price spend
editor.unpriceableBody: The factor set in force for {year} — {name} ({code}) — carries no per-€1000 spend factors, and no other active factor set carries any either. Spend lines cannot be added or priced until a factor set that has them is published and pinned to this period.
editor.unpriceableBodyNoSet: No active factor set carries per-€1000 spend factors, so nothing entered here can be priced for {year}. Spend lines can be added again once a factor set that has them is published and pinned to this period.
editor.unpriceableLines: Lines already entered are kept exactly as you entered them and are shown as unpriced — not as zero. A figure that cannot be produced is not a figure of nought.
editor.unpricedHint: No spend factor is available for this commodity, so this line produces no figure at all — not a zero.
editor.footnote: The client sends only commodity, amount and currency; the EXIOBASE factor and the annual FX rate are applied on the server, and a recalculation folds the result into your Scope-3 total. A currency without an FX rate for {year} saves the line but contributes 0 with a warning.
editor.errNegative: Spend must be a non-negative number.
editor.errValidation: Check the commodity, amount and currency.

executive.intro: The figures below come from the calculation run named in the methodology section. Gross totals cover Scope 1 and Scope 2 only; Scope 3 is estimated separately and is not added to them.
executive.noRun: This revision has no completed calculation run, so no emission figure is published here. Every figure below reads «not published» — it is not a zero, and it must not be read as one.
executive.failedRun: The calculation run did not complete: {failed} of {lines} lines could not be priced. No total is published, because the sum of the lines that did compute would look like an inventory while silently omitting the emissions nobody could price.
executive.qualified: Some figures below are withheld rather than estimated: the calculation publishes no number it cannot derive from recorded data. What is missing, and what it costs this report, is set out under «{section}».
executive.basisQualified: Some figures below rest on a weaker factor than the pinned factor set holds: a factor for the site's own country, or for the record's own year, exists in that set but the unit or the year of the record could not reach it. Nothing is withheld and nothing is estimated — every substitution is named, with the factor it was made instead of, under «{section}».

methodology.factorSource: Factor sources used by this run
methodology.scope1Intro: Every one of the five direct emission source categories is addressed below, including those this organisation does not have. A category that is simply absent from a report cannot be told apart from a category nobody looked at, which is why an absence is stated here rather than left blank.
methodology.categoryAssessed: Assessed. {rows} activity records were collected for {category}, of which {calculated} were priced by the calculation run.
methodology.categoryNotPresent: Not present at this organisation. No {category} activity occurs within the reporting boundary, so no data was collected and no emission is reported for it.
methodology.substitutionIntro: Every figure in this report was priced by the only factor of the pinned set the recorded data could reach. Where the set also holds a factor that would have priced a line better — one for the site's own country, or one for the record's own year — the substitution is stated below rather than left for a reader to discover. Nothing here was withheld and nothing was estimated; what changed is the strength of the basis, and this is what it changed to.

substitution.unit_unreachable: {activity}: {lines} calculation lines entered in {enteredUnit} were priced by the {chosenGeography} factor ({chosenSource}). The pinned set also holds a {betterGeography} factor for this activity ({betterSource}, {betterYear}), published per {betterUnits}; no conversion reaches those units from {enteredUnit}, so it could not be applied. The figure is the {chosenGeography} default, not the {betterGeography} measurement.
substitution.year_mismatch: {activity}: {lines} calculation lines for {year} were priced by the {chosenGeography} factor ({chosenSource}). The pinned set holds a {betterGeography} factor for this activity ({betterSource}), but only for {betterYear}. A factor published for another year is a different measurement, not an approximation of this one, so it was not substituted — and the figure is therefore the {chosenGeography} default rather than the {betterGeography} measurement.

qualifications.heading: Figures withheld or qualified
qualifications.intro: The calculation publishes no figure it cannot derive from recorded data. Where a figure is missing above, it was withheld rather than estimated, and the reason is stated below with the number of records concerned.
qualifications.none: No figure in this report was withheld by the calculation: every input the published figures needed was recorded.

reason.historical_context_missing: The original calculation context was not recorded. Historical turnover, intensity and energy split are unavailable; current organisation details and exchange rates have not been substituted.
reason.fx_rate_missing: {count} included legal entities report in a currency for which no exchange rate to the euro is recorded for {year}. The turnover and both emission intensities are therefore not published — converting at 1:1 would have reported another currency as euros, understating the intensity by whatever the true rate is.
reason.turnover_missing: {count} included legal entities have no turnover recorded. The intensity denominator would be short by their revenue, so no intensity is published: an emissions-per-euro figure computed over part of the group reads as if it covered all of it.
reason.currency_missing: {count} included legal entities have no reporting currency recorded, so their turnover cannot be converted to euros and no intensity is published.
reason.energy_unconvertible: {count} energy records are entered in a unit that no conversion reaches, so their volume never became MWh. No energy figure — neither the total nor the split — is published for the entities and sites those records belong to.
reason.renewable_share_missing: {count} energy records state no renewable share. Their volume is still counted in the total energy consumption, but the renewable / non-renewable split is withheld: putting unstated energy on the non-renewable line would claim, of energy whose provenance nobody recorded, that it was certainly not renewable.
reason.line_outside_boundary: {count} calculation lines belong to a legal entity that is not in the boundary aggregated here. They are inside the totals and inside no per-entity breakdown, which is the accounting gap the reconciliation reports.
reason.factor_basis_downgraded: {count} calculation lines were priced by a weaker basis than the pinned factor set offers: a factor for the site's own country, or for the record's own year, exists in the set, but the unit or the year of the record could not reach it. Those figures are published and not withheld; each substitution is named in the methodology section, with the factor that was passed over.

eligibility_sme.title: Micro, small or medium-sized enterprise with its seat in Slovenia
eligibility_sme.hosmos: The reporting entity's country and headcount. SME status itself is the applicant's to prove.

result.met: Seat: {country}; employees: {employees} — within the SME ceiling.
result.attention: Seat: {country}; employees: {employees}. Set the country to SI and record the headcount on the Organisation screen; more than 249 employees is outside the SME definition.

eligibility_employee.title: At least one employee for the duration of the project
eligibility_employee.hosmos: The headcount or average FTE of the reporting entity and the reporting period.

result.attention: No headcount recorded (employees: {employees}). Enter it on the Organisation screen.

funding.title: Co-financing of 60 %; subsidy between EUR 1,000 and EUR 9,999.99
funding.hosmos: Nothing — the budget is outside the platform. Only eligible external services count.

result.pending: Confirm once the offer and the budget are in place.

provider.title: The report is prepared by an external expert at market price
provider.hosmos: The export is fit for an external expert; the contract or order is outside HOSMOS.

result.pending: Confirm once the expert's contract or order exists.

independence.title: An independent review by an authorised audit firm; preparer and reviewer are not the same person
independence.hosmos: A locked revision, an immutable report render, and at least one member with a reviewing role (reviewer, approver, auditor).

result.met: Locked revision: yes; immutable renders: {renders}; reviewing roles: {reviewers}.
result.attention: Locked revision: {locked, select, 1 {yes} other {no}}; immutable renders: {renders}; reviewing roles: {reviewers}. Lock the revision, produce the report and invite the reviewer on the Settings screen.

standard.title: The report follows the current VSME (or the simplified ESRS) and the legislation
standard.hosmos: Every applicable Basic datapoint has a recorded answer or decision, with evidence where a figure needs it.

result.attention: Readiness {percent} %: {open} datapoints open, {needsEvidence} without evidence. Work through them on the Readiness screen.

publication.title: The report is publicly available on AJPES before the payment claim
publication.hosmos: The final PDF or report package from the Reports screen; the publication itself happens on AJPES.

result.pending: Confirm once the report is published on AJPES, with the link or date.

auditability.title: Every datapoint is traceable to its source
auditability.hosmos: Evidence links on records; source, period, unit, method, estimate flag and approvals on every row.

result.attention: Evidence links: {links}; datapoints still needing evidence: {needsEvidence}. Attach the documents on the Evidence screen.

versioning.title: The standard and the methodology version are fixed
versioning.hosmos: The factor set pinned by the period and the formula version of the latest calculation.

result.attention: Factor set {factorSet}; formula version {formulaVersion}. Pin the factor set on the period and run the calculation.

data_quality.title: Units, conversions and calculations are reproducible
data_quality.hosmos: A completed calculation that is not stale: every line carries its source unit, conversion and factor.

result.met: The latest calculation is complete and current.
result.attention: {calculated, select, 1 {The calculation is stale — inputs changed after it ran.} other {No calculation has been run.}} Run it on the Review screen.

social.title: Basic workforce, health-and-safety and remuneration datapoints are available
social.hosmos: Readiness of B8, B9 and B10.

result.attention: B8 {b8} %, B9 {b9} %, B10 {b10} %. Complete them on the Disclosures screen.

general_info.title: B1 and B2 export completely into the report
general_info.hosmos: Readiness of B1 (basis for preparation) and B2 (practices, policies, initiatives).

result.attention: B1 {b1} %, B2 {b2} %. B1 comes from the Organisation screen, B2 from Disclosures.

environmental.title: Basic B3, B6 and B7 data with their conditions
environmental.hosmos: Readiness of B3 (energy and GHG), B6 (water) and B7 (resource use and waste).

result.attention: B3 {b3} %, B6 {b6} %, B7 {b7} %. B3 comes from the inventory and the calculation; B6 and B7 from Disclosures.

comprehensive.title: C1–C9 may be included as a second module
comprehensive.hosmos: Whether the plan includes the Comprehensive module.

result.info: {available, select, 1 {The Comprehensive module is included in the plan.} other {The Comprehensive module is not in the plan; it is optional for the voucher.}}

micro_logic.title: For up to 10 employees the voluntary datapoints are applied correctly
micro_logic.hosmos: The headcount against the micro threshold and the count of voluntary datapoints in the catalogue.

result.info: Employees: {employees} — {micro, select, 1 {a micro-undertaking: the {voluntary} voluntary datapoints may be omitted} other {not a micro-undertaking; {voluntary} voluntary datapoints are optional as for every undertaking}}.

submission.title: Application through the SPS ePortal
submission.hosmos: Nothing — a project step outside the platform. The call is open until {closes} or until the funds are exhausted.

result.pending: Confirm once the application is submitted; the call closes on {closes}.

cookies.title: Cookies on this site
cookies.text: Necessary cookies keep you signed in and remember your language; they are always on. Analytics cookies are used only if you agree, and the site works exactly the same without them.

errorBoundary.title: This screen stopped working
errorBoundary.body: Something in the page failed while it was updating. Your saved data is untouched; anything you had typed and not saved is lost.
errorBoundary.translated: The page is being translated by the browser. Automatic translation rewrites the page under the app and breaks it as soon as you type. Turn the translation off for this site and pick your language with the switcher in the top right — the app speaks English, Slovene, Russian, German, Italian, Serbian and Croatian.
